comments.author: @sylvanaseymour
comments.text: That opening image of an interstate strip that could be almost anywhere is so effective. The sameness isn’t just in the buildings; it’s the whole pattern of roads, parking, chain shops and places designed for quick access. When the same template appears everywhere, local character becomes harder to recognise and easier to treat as unnecessary. I write about that gradual shift in my book Uglification and this video shows it playing out across the landscape.
